scenarios.title: Smooth run
scenarios.summary: A cooperative room for learning the normal Host and guest flow.

scenarios.title: Late arrivals and no-shows
scenarios.summary: Practice recovery when expected guests are missing or arrive after groups begin.

scenarios.title: Early exit and return
scenarios.summary: Rebalance when a guest leaves early and another returns later.

scenarios.title: Odd roster and capacity
scenarios.summary: Expose odd-sized groups, tight capacity, and unassigned guests.

scenarios.title: Walk-in and ambiguous claim
scenarios.summary: Practice admitting a walk-in and resolving two similar roster identities.

scenarios.title: Privacy and keep-apart
scenarios.summary: Respect an opt-out and a safety keep-apart constraint while preserving flow.

scenarios.title: Low connectivity
scenarios.summary: Continue through disconnects, delayed updates, and reconnection.

scenarios.title: Two hosts, one revision
scenarios.summary: Show how stale Host actions are rejected and recovered safely.

scenarios.title: Reveal interrupted
scenarios.summary: Pause and recover around a reveal or round transition.

scenarios.title: External and incomplete profiles
scenarios.summary: Exercise no-download guests and deliberately sparse participant data.

scenarios.title: Accountability sweep
scenarios.summary: Finish with unresolved checked-in, departed, and disconnected guests.
